Needs changes before merge: add the required screenshots. All local checks passed.

I read the complete diff and issue #3667. I checked the rules in current upstream `AGENTS.md`.
The trial merge used upstream main `10ea81a2a1da2f883d43385757db802e83c99fd1`.
Its first parent is the PR head above. The merge was clean.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings.rs:282` and the PR body: the UI change has no before/after screenshots. Add both screenshots to the PR body. Show the tool number action with T1 reserved for a probe, including the visible refusal after the change. Store the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not commit them to the PR branch.

The code uses the same reservation allocation as `AddTool`. The new tests cover the queued number command and the refusal text. I found no code blocker.

Local build and tests:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 29 steps passed; 0 failed. The app, post and UI test builds passed.
- `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps passed; 0 failed. All 11 light tests passed.

Extra suites run: the example catalog suites above ran by name in the quick gate. No fixture or importer files changed. The extra fixture and STEP suite rules do not apply.

Safety and mutations: the PR changes the UI command comparison and refusal text. The allocation algorithm and safety checks stay the same. It changes no G-code generation, collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. No mutation runs apply. No goldens moved. Full heavy lanes were not required.

There is no earlier review to check. Per the instruction for this run, I left the labels, title and draft state unchanged. The worktree and build cache remain at `.claude/worktrees/review-3976`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
